0.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_TALK_ACTOR
0.description: The name's Rowena. I used to be a travelin' weapons merchant, till some noble from Ishgard saw my collection. Said I had me an eye for quality, and asked if I'd like to work for him, helpin' to barter his collection away for all manner o' rare artifacts.

1.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_010
1.description: You managed to get Gerolt to reforge one o' the arms of eld? <hex:021A020203>Gerolt<hex:021A020103>?<hex:02100103>...I'm impressed. If ever you tire o' the adventurin' life, I could always use another <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> who knows how to <hex:021A020203>move<hex:021A020103> people.

2.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_020
2.description: Collectors far and wide've been fairly frothin' at the mouth for the primal wares you're bringin' in. Keep up the good work, you hear?

3.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_030
3.description: These Domans, I hear they've got their own peculiar fightin' style. I reckon I smell an opportunity.

4.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_040
4.description: ...Crystal Braves, eh? Can't say I'm keen on the name, but as long as there's coin to be made, you could call yourselves the Flying Faeries for all I care.

5.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_050
5.description: Aye, I've heard the rumors. Don't you worry your little head off, though─I'll keep on doin' business with you. Rumors are words and words are wind. But coin is coin, and yours is as good as the next man's.

6.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_060
6.description: So, you're cleared of all charges. I'm happy for you. Just don't expect any favors because your honor's suddenly intact again. With me, it's always business as usual.

7.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_065
7.description: I ain't normally one to accept alternative forms o' payment─especially for debts, mind─but this bloke's miniature aetheryte has been a bloody godssend, what with me havin' to split my time between the Toll and Idyllshire.

8.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_066
8.description: Only saves me a short walk to the one outside, but when you're busy as I am, every minute of every hour of every day matters.

17.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_100
17.description: They're relics from the Allagan Empire, a civilization what thrived durin' the Third Astral Era. That's around five thousand years ago, in case you're wonderin'.

18.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_101
18.description: Despite their tiny size, each one's said to contain a library's worth o' knowledge o' the past.

19.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_102
19.description: They've gained some amount o' popularity among the rich eccentrics o' the realm, who buy the tomestones from me by the bagful. An' for my part, I source them from adventurers like yourself.

20.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_103
20.description: The Allagan Empire once spanned all Eorzea, so there's no shortage o' places where tomestones might be found. Bring me whatever you come upon durin' your escapades, an' I'll strike you a deal.

21.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_110
21.description: In recent years, folk've begun takin' a renewed interest in antiquity.

22.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_111
22.description: In the case o' the adventurin' crowd, this interest takes the form of ancient combat arts along with the equipment used in 'em.

23.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_112
23.description: To cater to the demand for the latter, I've engaged master artisans to recreate vintage armor usin' modern-day techniques. If you fancy such gear, you can get 'em right here at the House o' Splendors.

24.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_120
24.description: They're arms an' armor crafted by Gerolt, who has the dubious honor o' bein' both Eorzea's finest weaponsmith <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> its vilest man.

25.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_121
25.description: Though he's constantly drownin' in drink these days, put a hammer in his hand, an' he transforms into bloody Byregot Himself. Just imagine, then, what the fellow was capable of when he still had his wits about him.

26.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_122
26.description: From armorcraft to weavin', he mastered all there was to be mastered as an artisan, an' created works of unsurpassed quality what are still sought after to this day.

27.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_123
27.description: It just so happens I've managed to procure some o' these rare articles. Just so you know, though, owin' to their age, the wares might be a touch worn.

28.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_124
28.description: If you want them returned to mint condition, you'll want to talk to the fool as went an' became Gerolt's apprentice. The lad can handle the restoration, or so I'm told.

29.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_200
29.description: The folks o' Garlond Ironworks are credited for bringin' the marvels o' magitek to Eorzea. If it weren't for them, we wouldn't have nice things like airships.

30.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_201
30.description: The company's named for its founder an' president, Cid Garlond, a Garlean engineer. He's president only in name, though. From what I know, the man spends all o' his time gallivantin' about, doin' his own thing.

31.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_202
31.description: Neglected by its founder, the Ironworks threatened to, well, founder. But thankfully, Cid's deputy took the helm an' righted the ship. Jessie's her name, an' hers is the genius mind behind the Ironworks gear.

32.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_203
32.description: These are superior wares, make no mistake, an' I have the privilege o' bein' the sole supplier in Eorzea. If you fancy them, go an' talk to Auriana out front. She'll fix you up with whatever piece you want, assumin' you can pay for it.

33.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_204
33.description: Oh, an' you'll be pleased to know that Ironworks gear can be made even stronger than they already are. I've struck a deal with Gerolt, an' he'll do the augmentin' work for my customers.

34.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_205
34.description: Knowin' that lazy bastard, though, odds are he's foisted the responsibility on his apprentice. Drake, I think the fool's name was.

35.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_250
35.description: I've managed to strike an exclusive deal with a merchant operatin' out of Othard.

36.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_251
36.description: With the Domans' help, I've managed to strike an exclusive deal with a merchant operatin' out of Othard.

37.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_252
37.description: The fellow supplies me with all sorts of exotic Far Eastern wares. You won't find their like anywhere else in Eorzea.

38.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_253
38.description: If you reckon you might fancy these pieces, go and have a chat with Azena yonder. Prices ain't cheap, but so it goes with rare items from the other side o' the world.

39.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_130
39.description: You want to know 'bout this little place? It's a reward o' sorts, given over for my use in recognition o' my contributions to Revenant's Toll's growth.

40.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_131
40.description: There're parts what're still under construction, but it's comin' along nicely. The plan's to consolidate all my services under one roof, then gradually expand into other areas.

41.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_132
41.description: As to be expected, there's some as don't take kindly to my movin' up in the world. If that ain't sour grapes, I don't know what is. In life, if you don't want to get buggered, you've got to be the one doin' the buggerin'.

42.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_140
42.description: You want to know 'bout this little place? It's a reward o' sorts, given over for my use in recognition o' my contributions to Revenant's Toll's growth.

43.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_141
43.description: O' late, I've expanded to include a café on the upper level terrace. There, folk can enjoy specialties made with rich tomato relish while takin' in the hustle and bustle below.

44.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_142
44.description: Word's been spreadin', and we're startin' to get custom from faraway places. If you haven't been to the café yet, go on up and take a peek. Don't worry─I won't charge you for the view.

45.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_150
45.description: You want to know 'bout this little place? It's a reward o' sorts, given over for my use in recognition o' my contributions to Revenant's Toll's growth.

46.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_151
46.description: From the café on the upper level terrace, you can take in the hustle and bustle below while enjoyin' specialties made with rich tomato relish.

47.name: TEXT_REGWILROWENA_00106_ROWENA_000_152
47.description: O' late, though, it's our Far Eastern cuisine what seems to be drawin' the biggest crowds. The ex-adventurer chef introduced it, he says it's a labor o' love. As long as it's bringin' in coin, he'll hear no complaints from me.
